events.name: A Drag Queen Christmas
events.info: Murray & Peter Present A Drag Queen Christmas hosted by Nina West. Its the longest running drag tour in America. Get ready for your favorite queens performing live on stage. We have got Myki Meeks, Nini Coco, Darlene Mitchell, Juicy Love Dion, Discord Addams, Crystal Methyd and Silky Ganache. VIP Meet & Greet add-on tickets are sold separately. To attend the M&G, fans must also purchase a ticket to the show. There will be a 20-minute intermission. 18+ welcome. Check DragFans.com for tour info.
events.pleaseNote: Meet & Greet Experience Add-On available for purchase on TM.com. Note: This is an additional ticket purchased, purchasing the ADD-ON does NOT get you into the event. It is only a Meet & Greet ticket. Fans must also purchase a general concert ticket to enter the venue. Meet & Greet Experience includes an exclusive photo opportunity with the entire cast on the main stage before the show. Fans also receive an amazing holiday clack fan and a souvenir laminate with lanyard. Plus get early access to purchase tour merch. (The queens will autograph any of their own merch purchased at the venue).

Will Call is available during regular Ticket Office Hours at the Stockton Arena Ticket Office. When picking up Will Call, all patrons must have ID and the Credit Card used to purchase the tickets.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible Seating is available on all levels of Stockton Arena. Interpreting Services: Guest requiring interpreting services must contact Guest Services at 209-373-1400 within two (2) weeks of the scheduled event. Service animals for disabled patrons is permitted.

generalInfo.childRule: Any child who has celebrated their 2nd Birthday must have a ticket, regardless if they will occupy a seat. This policy is for all events unless otherwise noted.
